title: Craft beam lasers over nuclear stockpiles at Loring AFB
place_text: Loring Air Force Base, northern Maine

tellings.quote: They had a a episode. It was either 1975 or 1976 where craft were coming over the base and these laser type beams were coming out and they were mapping the nuclear stockpiles.

plain: A man named Charlie Foltz, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that in 1975 or 1976, at Loring Air Force Base, a US military base in northern Maine, unknown craft flew over the base. He says laser-like beams came out of them and were mapping the base's nuclear weapons stores, which would mean someone unknown was taking an interest in American nuclear weapons.
